Build (and optionally cache) the unified pep_all table from raw search output

Source: R/build-pep-all.R
build_pep_all.Rd

Reads, parses, and annotates LC-MS search-engine output into the unified long-format pep_all table, dispatching on software to the right loader family (FragPipe / DIA-NN / PEAKS). This is the parsing step that the 00_mhc_report template runs inline; extracting it here lets the focused report templates (01_mhc_overview, 02_prot_all, 03_lcms_qc, 04_pepchem, 05_quant_stats) share one cached pep_all instead of each re-parsing the raw files: run build_pep_all() once (writing the .rda via file_rda), then render any subset of those reports, each of which simply load()s the cache.

Usage

build_pep_all(
  software,
  folder_data,
  annotation,
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
  instrument = "tims_tof",
  test_mode = FALSE,
  file_rda = NULL,
  dictionary = NULL
)

Arguments

software

One of "fragpipe_dda_combined", "fragpipe_dda_individual", "diann", "peaks_xpro", or "custom" — selects the loader branch (and, for FragPipe, the combined-vs-individual annotation mode). "custom" routes through the dictionary-driven parser (see dictionary).

folder_data

Path to the folder holding the per-sample search output (the report's FolderData).

annotation

Annotation data frame (e.g. from read_annot()); used to restrict the batch read to annotated samples and to join sample metadata.

shortpep_range

Length-2 numeric vector c(min, max); the biologically expected ligand-length window, forwarded to the parse_*() step to set Length_range.

instrument

Instrument string ("tims_tof", "faims_orbi", "orbi"); only affects the PEAKS loader's ion-mobility handling.

test_mode

If TRUE, the batch readers reduce each file to its first ~100 rows per run (fast iteration on a small but representative subset: every run, Condition and replicate of the experiment is still present, which a plain head-of-file truncation would not give for a combined export). Ignored by the PEAKS loader.

file_rda

Optional path. When non-NULL, pep_all is save()d there (as the object name pep_all) so report templates can load() it.

dictionary

Required when software = "custom": either a path to a YAML parser dictionary or an already-loaded dictionary list (see read_dictionary() / get_dictionary_template()). Its read: block sets the per-sample filename and delimiter, and its mode: the annotation join. Ignored for the built-in loaders.

Value

The pep_all data frame, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
annot <- read_annot("1_documentation/sample_annotation_dda_all.csv")
build_pep_all(
  software       = "fragpipe_dda_combined",
  folder_data    = "2_data",
  annotation     = annot,
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
  file_rda       = "2_data/dda_all_pep_all.rda"
)
# then render any focused report against the cache:
run_howmahico_report("01_mhc_overview", params = list(...), output_file = "01.html")
} # }
